verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses AI training data opt-out, a privacy policy on model training, or any control to prevent user data from being used to train AI models; the evidence pack focuses entirely on feature descriptions (auto-drafts, labeling, MCP integrations) with no mention of data usage/training policy. Missing for 10: any documented opt-out/consent mechanism, privacy policy statement on AI training, or third-party confirmation of such a control.
